notes: v1.14.531 — RACK DETAIL: DEAD 3D MOUNT REMOVED (Ship A of RACK-DETAIL-CLEANUP). The rack-detail elevation card carried two sibling surfaces inside #reh3dCanvasHost: #rehFlatWrap, which renders, and #reh3dMount, which did not — leaving a control rail over an empty box. The mount and the reh3d_restore(rack) call that fed it are both removed, so the flat U-rail elevation is the single rack visual on this page and is no longer a fallback. Removing the CALL is load-bearing, not tidying: reh3d_activate3D adds .is-3d before it looks for the mount, and .is-3d hides #rehFlatWrap at :11276, so leaving it would have emptied the card entirely. #reh3dCanvasHost keeps its id (shared guards read it). OPEN AISLE is untouched and still wired to forge3d_open(). rackElevation_render3D stays live for the Build preview, the Command hero and the RackEngine re-acquire paths.
